## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): strong oscillations, light pocket + unresolved heavy budget

Raw |Rxx|(B) first (both runs complete, `data/6` 921 pts 0→10 T, `data/7` 486 pts 10→0.3 T), then the tone read. **Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_full = 33.1 T):** a dominant **light fundamental F = 7.1 T** (SNR ≈ 40–100, harmonics tracked to 4×; onset *censored at the 0.3 T record edge* — oscillations persist to the lowest field measured), plus low-F content (3.0/4.2/5.2 T, edge-censored) and high-F FFT content at 21.3 / 30.2 T. The light pocket carries only **0.69×10¹² (21 %)** of the total density — the **residual 26.0 T of frequency budget** must sit in heavier band(s), and the observed 21.3/30.2 T peaks are each consistent with *either* 3×/4× harmonics of 7.1 (21.3, 28.4) *or* fundamentals near the 26 T budget, unresolvable at a single density (window ΔF ≈ 2–2.4 T). **Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_full = 12.4 T):** balanced multi-tone read (4.7, 6.6, 8.5, 12.3 T; 12.3 ≈ F_full) — the near-CNP semimetal regime, no clean read. **Model comparison:** a strong light fundamental at 3.2×10¹² is *incompatible with a single-surface (ABCA-singleton) picture* at this density and matches the ABAB prediction (light ≈ 7.5 T) — but ABCB also carries a light pocket, and LK damping at T_e ≈ 8 K does **not** kill the heavy candidates at high B (X = 14.7·m*·T/B → R_T ≥ 0.3 for m* ≤ 0.075 at B ≥ 3 T), so the heavy structure is *resolvable and missing-in-ambiguity*, not absent. **The discriminator is F(n) slopes:** a k-th harmonic disperses at exactly k× the fundamental's slope, an independent band at its own slope with the sum rule ΣF(n) = 10.34 T per 10¹² cm⁻²; region-B mosaic tones ride at n + 0.43×10¹² (run-5 read). → next: **`landau-fan` along D = 0** (plan step 4).

"""sdh-spot-check runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12) & 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12), D = 0, run-5 calibration.
Raw |Rxx|(B) first, then per-trace SdH read: tone table (sdh_onset) + FFT in 1/B, and the
Luttinger sum-rule arithmetic that frames the landau-fan design."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
reads = {}
for k, (rid, blo) in enumerate({6: 1.5, 7: 1.0}.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    chans = resolve_channels(r.meta); cur = current_channel(chans)
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    I = r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    vch = [c for c in chans if not c.is_current][0]
    R = np.abs((r.col(vch.col) / vch.gain) / I)
    print(f"===== run {rid}: {r.tags[0].split(';')[0]} =====")
    print(f"rows {r.rows} (complete: {not r.interrupted}), I_bias med {np.median(np.abs(I))*1e9:.2f} nA, "
          f"R range {R.min():.0f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm (sens 50 uV = 5.05 kOhm FS)")
    try:
        o = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I)))
        print(o.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print("SdhOnsetError:", e)

    sel = B > blo
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R[sel][:, None], B[sel], nfft=2048)
    spec = spec[0]
    pk, _ = find_peaks(spec, height=0.05 * spec[f > 2].max())
    pk = sorted([p for p in pk if f[p] > 2], key=lambda p: -spec[p])[:6]
    print("top FFT peaks (B > %.1f T): " % blo + ", ".join(f"{f[p]:.2f} T ({spec[p]:.0f})" for p in pk))
    reads[rid] = (f, spec, pk)

    ax[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.4, color='k')
    ax[k, 0].set_xlabel('B (T)'); ax[k, 0].set_ylabel('|Rxx| (Ohm)')
    ax[k, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — {'electron n=+3.2e12' if rid == 6 else 'hole n=-1.2e12'}, D=0")
    ax[k, 1].plot(f, spec, lw=0.8)
    for p in pk:
        ax[k, 1].annotate(f"{f[p]:.1f}", (f[p], spec[p]), fontsize=7, ha='center', xytext=(0, 3), textcoords='offset points')
    ax[k, 1].set_xlim(0, 60); ax[k, 1].set_xlabel('F (T)'); ax[k, 1].set_ylabel('FFT mag')
    ax[k, 1].set_title(f'run {rid} FFT in 1/B, B > {blo} T')
    print()

# Luttinger sum-rule arithmetic (full spin-valley degeneracy 4)
for n12, F_light in ((3.2, 7.11), (-1.2, None)):
    F_full = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    line = f"n = {n12:+.1f}e12: F_full (single 4-fold surface) = {F_full:.1f} T"
    if F_light:
        n_l = F_light / F_full * abs(n12)
        line += (f"; observed light fundamental {F_light:.1f} T carries {n_l:.2f}e12 ({100*F_light/F_full:.0f}%)"
                 f" -> residual heavy-band frequency budget {F_full - F_light:.1f} T")
    print(line)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan along D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking discriminator

> **05:27** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.27..+3.25e12 (66 cols, co-swept Vtg/Vbg), B 0.45->10 T uniform-1/B (256 rows, Nyq 60 T), sr1 100 uV; ends 10 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~12:57** (≈7h30m)

**Plan step 4** (`hera_scratch/plan.md`; runs 6–7 read in ana cells 14–15). The spot checks leave a single ambiguity the fan is built to break: run 6's light fundamental (7.1 T at n = +3.2×10¹², 21 % of the density) leaves a 26 T heavy budget whose observed high-F content (21.3 / 30.2 T) is indistinguishable at one density from 3×/4× harmonics. In the fan, a k-th harmonic disperses at exactly k× its fundamental's slope while an independent band has its own slope with ΣF(n) = 10.34 T per 10¹² cm⁻²; branch count + slope partition then separates ABCA (single surface tracking 10.34·n) / ABAB (bilayer-like light+heavy pair) / ABCB (monolayer-like + bilayer-like), with region-B mosaic ghosts expected offset +0.43×10¹² in n (run-5 read).

**Design.** Fast axis: (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept (`multimegasweep`) along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line, uniform in n over the full validator-allowed window n = −1.27 … +3.25×10¹² (66 cols, Δn = 0.070×10¹²; **no n coverage trade** — TG-limited on both ends). Slow axis: B = 0.45 → 10 T (session cap), **256 rows uniform in 1/B** — sdh_fft's no-resample path; Δ(1/B) = 8.3×10⁻³ ⇒ Nyquist 60 T (covers 4× harmonics and sum tones seen in run 6), ΔF = 0.47 T per column, B_lo set by the run-6 onset (censored at 0.3 T; 0.45 T keeps 4–9 light-tone periods below 1 T at acceptable cost). Ascending from 0 T where the handoff parked the magnet; **ends at 10 T, gates parked at 0** (field not re-traversed; step 5 plans from 10 T). Sensitivity 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS: flanks (70–600 Ω, runs 6–7) keep ≥ 16× headroom; the ν = 0/CNP stripe (240 Ω at B = 0) **may rail at high B if a gap develops — accepted**, the rail is bounded to the stripe and is itself evidence; sizing per the run-4 lesson. fast_delay 1.0 s (= 3.3 τ at τ 0.3 s / 24 dB — same knowing bend as run 5), slow_delay 3.0 s.

**Price (measured rates).** Gate rows: 256 × 66 × 1.098 s (run-5 in-row median) = 310 min. Ramps: 10.0 T total traverse / 0.137 T·min⁻¹ = 73 min. Row overhead (3 s driver settle + ~2.8 s flyback + 3 s slow_delay, run-5/6 calibrations) = 38 min. Total 420 min ≈ 7.0 h; with this session's +5–10 % actuals: **≈ 7 h 30 m**.

**Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed before start): first rows ~6 min in — leakage < 1 nA, no rail outside the CNP stripe, live channels; then interim reads every ~45–60 min with partial fan re-forms; branch-map FFT reads once rows reach ~2 T and ~5 T. Abort criteria: leak trip, rail spreading beyond the ν = 0 wedge, T_sample off base, field readback diverging from setpoints.

# === Landau fan along D = 0 (`landau-fan`): (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept fast on the calibrated D = 0 line, B slow 0.45 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_FAST, N_B, B_LO, B_HI = 66, 256, 0.45, 10.0

# fast axis: densest D = 0 window inside the validators (2 mV margin), uniform in n
_ns = np.linspace(-1.5, 4.0, 5501)
_Vt, _Vb = calc_gate_voltages(_ns, np.zeros_like(_ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
_ok = (_Vt >= TG_MIN + 0.002) & (_Vt <= TG_MAX - 0.002) & (_Vb >= BG_MIN + 0.002) & (_Vb <= BG_MAX - 0.002)
n_vec = np.linspace(_ns[_ok].min(), _ns[_ok].max(), N_FAST)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())

# slow axis: uniform in 1/B, ascending from where the magnet sits (0 T after the handoff park)
B_vec = np.round(1.0 / np.linspace(1.0 / B_LO, 1.0 / B_HI, N_B), 4)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
_dinv = np.abs(np.diff(1.0 / B_vec))
print(f"fast: n = {n_vec[0]:+.3f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.3f} e12 ({N_FAST} cols, dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}); "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {N_B} rows uniform in 1/B; Nyquist {1/(2*_dinv.mean()):.1f} T, dF res {1/(1/B_LO-1/B_HI):.2f} T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0.45), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Flank R stays 70-600 Ohm
# (runs 6-7); the CNP/nu=0 stripe (240 Ohm at B=0, run 5) may exceed FS at high B if a gap
# develops -- accepted, bounded rail on the stripe only (stated in the proposal markdown).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D=0: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({N_FAST} cols), B {B_LO}->{B_HI} T uniform-1/B ({N_B} rows), "
                  f"run-5 cal, sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.0, slow_delay 3.0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}): '
              f'fast (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept, n = {n_vec[0]:+.3f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.3f} e12, {N_FAST} cols; '
              f'slow B = {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {N_B} rows uniform in 1/B (Nyquist 60 T); sr1 100 uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=3.0, fast_delay=1.0)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
# field stays at 10 T (never re-traverse; the next step plans from there)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

# === Kernel-binding probe (read-only) ===
# First E1 act after the grant: confirms the nb-collab execute path lands on the
# operator's instrument-carrying kernel (the one that ran Setup + SAFETIES), not
# a fresh python3 kernel. Touches no instrument — namespace only.
import os
_need = ['magnet', 'heater', 'sr0', 'sr1', 'sr2', 'sr3', 'k_2400_tg', 'k_2400_bg',
         'dc205', 'k_tg', 'k_bg', 'k_si', 'T_sample', 'T_vaporizer', 'meas_config',
         'WIRING', 'state0', 'cal', 'B_SESSION_CAP', 'T_SESSION_CAP', 'tg_lims', 'bg_lims']
_missing = [n for n in _need if n not in globals()]
print(f"pid {os.getpid()} | main_dir {main_dir if 'main_dir' in globals() else '<unset>'}")
print(f"present: {len(_need) - len(_missing)}/{len(_need)} | missing: {_missing}")
print("KERNEL PROBE:", "BOUND" if not _missing else "UNBOUND")
